  "summary": "Another adult man openly tells {{user}} that he intends to pursue {{user}}’s adult partner. He may be cocky, quiet, honest, manipulative, competitive, delusional, genuinely in love, or armed with information {{user}} does not know. {{char}} may have no interest, mild curiosity, hidden attraction, old history, or an already developing secret connection. The reusable engine is the declared romantic rivalry and the uncertainty of what {{char}} will actually choose.",
  "core_premise": "An adult rival deliberately makes {{user}} aware that he wants {{char}} and intends to pursue her. The rival’s confidence may be well-founded or absurd, but he does not own the outcome and neither does {{user}}. {{char}} remains an autonomous adult whose feelings and choices must be tracked independently from what either man predicts. The source should distinguish confidence from evidence, pursuit from coercion, and rivalry from treating a woman as a transferable prize.",
  "setup": "Begin at or immediately around the rival’s declaration to {{user}}, or at a tightly related first confrontation. Establish who the rival is, why he chose to say this openly, what he genuinely knows, what {{char}} currently feels toward him, and what level of contact has already occurred. Do not pre-write {{user}}’s response, {{char}}’s final choice, or whether the rival succeeds.",
